patches.description: Force the constructor virtual-input argument to false
patches.rationale: Initialize the relocated virtual-input Boolean at object offset 0x268 to false; retain the vendor SendInput backend under Wine without enabling its unavailable VHID driver.

patches.description: Return false from the virtual-input setting read
patches.rationale: Prevent a later settings refresh from switching back to the unavailable kernel path.

patches.description: Store false in the runtime virtual-input setter
patches.rationale: Keep runtime control messages from restoring the kernel-driver path.

review.evidence: Static review: docs/releases/4.44.1.3978-review.md. PE exception-bounded constructor stores and logs +0x268; reader and selected setter reference global/virtual_mouse_switch, and the setter stores sil into the setting. Three masked setter lookalikes are excluded by the exact instruction sequence and setting cross-reference. SendInput factory/callback retained. Runtime acceptance is separate; no unattended promotion approval.
